name: Maple Cinnamon Quinoa Porridge with Blueberry Compote
instructions: Place quinoa, milk, maple syrup, salt, and cinnamon in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Once the quinoa mixture comes to a boil, reduce heat to low, allow to cool slightly, and cover with a lid. Cook until most of the liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes.
Add the blueberries and maple syrup to another small saucepan. Heat on medium-high, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, divide porridge between bowls, drizzle with more milk, and top with blueberry compote. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
